educationalGoal:
Students will learn:
(1) continuity of a function.
(2) functions using parameters.
(3) increase or decrease of functions.
(4) integration by parts and integration by substitution.
advice:
This is a basic course in mathematics and science for engineer. We will cover the following topics:

1. Continuity of a function.
2. Functions using parameters.
3. Increase or decrease of functions.
4. Integration by parts and integration by substitution.

Extra classes may be held depending the comprehension level of students.
Students are required to review and preview each class. As a matter of particular emphasis, students are required to attempt the exercises after each class.
Extra materials may be distributed if necessary.
Students are required to show their procedure for solution/calculation logically and clearly in each assignment.
Students are expected to utilize the Math. and Science Education Research Center or the office hours of the instructor.

requiredKnowledge:
Skills and knowledge from the Mathematics and Science for Engineer I and II.
Basic calculation skills of numerical formulas (expansion, factorization, division, and calculation of fractional formula) and calculus.

activityGoals.body: Understand the concept of functions using parameters and find their derivatives.
Find the derivatives using the method of the logarithmic differentiation.
Examine the increase or decrease of functions using higher order derivatives and draw graphs of the functions.
Use integration by parts and integration by substitution to find integrals of various functions.
Understand the meanings of fundamental English words for mathematics.
Be able to demonstrate an understanding of all topics, attend every class, and do the required works.

achievementLevels.ideal:
(1) Fully understand the concept of functions using parameters and find their derivatives.
(2) Accurately find the derivatives using the method of the logarithmic differentiation.
(3) Accurately examine the increase or decrease of functions using higher order derivatives and draw graphs of the functions.
(4) Accurately find integrals of various functions using integration by parts and integration by substitution.
(5) Demonstrate an understanding of all topics and complete all assignments.
achievementLevels.standard:
(1) Understand the concept of functions using parameters and find their derivatives.
(2) Find the derivatives using the method of the logarithmic differentiation.
(3) Examine the increase or decrease of functions using higher order derivatives and draw graphs of the functions.
(4) Find integrals of various functions using integration by parts and integration by substitution.
(5) Demonstrate an understanding of all topics and complete all assignments.
